summary: Tested 4 features: (1) Backend POST /api/proposals/{id}/items/bulk-reorder, (2) Backend PUT /api/events/{id} with event_dates sort/dedupe, (3) Frontend section drag handles + reorder persistence, (4) Frontend Add Item modal auto-filling event_date. All 4 features working correctly. 5/5 pytest tests pass. Manual UI testing via Playwright also passes for both frontend flows.
critical_code_review_comments: ProposalEditor.js is now >4300 lines — consider splitting into smaller modules (SortableItem, SortableSectionWrapper, dialogs) for maintainability.

bulk_reorder_order_items endpoint does not validate that item_ids belong to the proposal_id (it filters by proposal_id+company_id so foreign IDs silently get 0 updates). Consider returning a 400 if any item_id is missing instead of silent skip; today the 'updated < total' delta is the only signal.
seed_data_creation: No new seed data. Used existing event_42ccd0133529 (Reorder Test Event, proposal prop_e45ef7945072 with Entradas/Principales sections) and event_14c8a303ed44 (Wedding García, event_date 2026-06-15).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend bulk-reorder verified: returns {updated, total}, persists sort_order and section_title, returns 404 for missing proposal. Event update with event_dates sorts ascending and deduplicates, also filters empty strings. Frontend: section-drag-handle-sectionhdr::<title> handles render and dnd-kit drag triggers bulk-reorder API (verified persistence after reload — Entradas/Principales swap stayed swapped). Add Item modal: Event Day input pre-fills with event.event_date (verified 2026-06-15 for Wedding García). data-testid='add-item-btn' works.
